+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

         let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

         let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

+//! Fast-path matching is deliberately conservative: input is normalized for

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

     fn save_chat_history(&mut self) {
         let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {

+        }

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

         let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

         let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.

+    query

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(

+                )

+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

         let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {

 succeeded in 0ms:
ID: forge-e98b561a
Title: Add local fast-path for common chat queries to skip LLM round-trip
Status: Closed
Priority: P3
Revision: 5
Created: 2026-08-14T16:16:57.236824465Z
Updated: 2026-08-17T04:26:58.306347265Z
Description: Every chat query in the : interface goes through a full LLM API call via
forge-chat's tool-based backend (ADR 0004), even high-frequency, exact-match
queries like "what did I spend today" or "show P0 tasks" that map 1:1 to an
existing hotkey/view or a single cheap forge-cost query. grep across
crates/forge-chat/src confirms there's no local pattern-matching layer - every
message is dispatched to the configured chat_backend before any tool runs.

Add a small local fast-path in forge-chat that matches a short, explicit list
of common phrasings (case-insensitive, no fuzzy NLP) to their equivalent
tool call/view switch and answers directly without invoking the LLM backend -
cuts latency (no network round-trip) and API cost for the most common
interactions. Anything that doesn't match the fast-path list falls through to
the existing LLM-backed path unchanged, so this is purely additive and doesn't
touch ADR 0004's architecture for the general case.

Files:
- crates/forge-chat/src/lib.rs or a new crates/forge-chat/src/fast_path.rs
- wire-in point: wherever chat_input is currently handed to the configured
  provider (see crates/forge-tui/src/app.rs chat submit handler)
Assignee: codex-gpt-5.6-luna-xhigh-luna-seam
Type: task

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

+/// Normalize only formatting that should not affect an exact phrase match.
+fn normalize_query(query: &str) -> String {
+    query
+        .trim()
+        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.'])
+        .trim()
+        .split_whitespace()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join(" ")
+        .to_ascii_lowercase()
 }

+    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.
+    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {
+        let result = self
+            .fast_path_matcher
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));
+        let action = match result {
+            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,
+            _ => return false,
+        };
+
+        let response_text = match action {
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Costs);
+                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;
+                if cost_data.today.is_some() {
+                    format!(
+                        "Today's spending: {} ({} calls, {} tokens).",
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),
+                        cost_data.today_calls(),
+                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),
+                    )
+                } else {
+                    "Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.".to_string()
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {
+                self.switch_view(View::Workers);
+                format!(
+                    "Workers view opened ({} workers).",
+                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()
+                )
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {
+                self.priority_filter = priority;
+                self.task_search_mode = false;
+                self.task_search_query.clear();
+                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);
+                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);
+                match priority {
+                    Some(priority) => format!("Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).", priority, count),
+                    None => format!("Tasks view opened ({} ready).", count),
+                }
+            }
+            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {
+                let view = match target {
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,
+                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,
+                };
+                self.switch_view(view);
+                format!("{} view opened.", view.title())
+            }
+        };
+
+        let exchange = ChatExchange {
+            user_query: query.to_string(),
+            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),
+            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
+            is_error: false,
+            tool_calls: vec![],
+            side_effects: vec![],
+            confirmation: None,
+            metadata: ResponseMetadata {
+                provider: "local-fast-path".to_string(),
+                ..ResponseMetadata::default()
+            },
+            error_guidance: None,
+        };
+        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);
+        self.chat_history.push(exchange);
+        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {
+            self.chat_history.remove(0);
+        }
+        self.status_message = Some(response_text);
+        self.mark_dirty();
+        true
+    }
+

         let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {
